problem.title: Maximum Score Words Formed by Letters
problem.problemStatement: Given a list of words, available letters, and individual letter scores, determine the maximum total score obtainable by selecting a subset of words such that every selected word can be formed using the available letters.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines contain one word each. • Next line contains the available letters. • Last line contains 26 integers representing the score of each lowercase letter.
